cs.t: I have a 24 inch samsung and the size is perfect as a single monitor. I, like many, don't like looking at two or more different screens. The only thing I would be aware of is that unfortunately with my macbook pro the quality of the samsung just doesnt compare to an apple display and i fiddled with the settings for ages. Adjustable height and rotation was really important for me, and the quality is good enough for the cost.
